value.author: codex
value.text: Wave verification 2026-07-10: found a REAL pre-existing upsert bug (in scope for this hardening PR). pm create maps synonym types (bug->Issue) but pm update rejects them, so upsert re-import of a synonym-typed bead failed the record and the --replace-deps pass silently dropped every dependency edge pointing at it (reproduced live: bd-2<-bd-1 and bd-4<-bd-1 lost). Fixed: (1) retry pm update without --type on invalid_argument_value + Invalid type value, preserving the canonical type from create; (2) on matched-record failure still map beadId->existingPmId so inbound edges survive replace-deps. Added isInvalidTypeValueError + 2 regression tests (84/84 pass). Verified live in throwaway workspace: upsert now updates 4/4 and relinks all 4 edges. Also verified: validate-only, batch-size, combined filters, export dry-run, merge-strategy skip/fail atomicity, cycle detection, 30k-node chain, NOT_FOUND exit 3, malformed JSONL exit 1 with per-line errors, no stack traces.
